content:
If you get a Thunderbird startup window like the one shown in my attached picture you are probably seeing one of these bugs https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2071951 or https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2075935 or maybe both.

The only solution I know to "unblock" Thunderbird and get it reactive again is to delete the session.json file from the Thunderbird profile folder. I have described this manipulation in this message https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/questions/1613132#answer-1858261

If this solution works for you and until the bug gets fixed, avoid to leave many messages - in particular PDF files - still opened in tabs when you close Thunderbird.
